x: A new holder was also produced in the Senior 100 yards, the finalists being Mayers, Walden, Butler, Merrett, Key and Holtum., Merrett eventually winning from Mayers with Walden third.
Merrett, Holtum and Mayers all qualified for the semi-final of the 220 yards and Merret and Mayers went on to the final in which Dennis was third and Ivan fifth.

The highlights of this year's Championships, held on 15th and 16th July, as far as Belgrave was concerned. was the excellent running of Ron Holtum to be the first Belgrave Harrier to reach the final of the 100 yards, for as long as most of us can remember, and Dennis Merrett's third place in the 220 yards Hurdles.
